research.title: Preprocessing and Baseline Evaluation for Support Request Classification
bullets: Implemented assigned text normalization and label mapping routines for support requests, following the research group's preprocessing specification.
Ran an established TF-IDF classification pipeline and inspected misclassified requests to document recurring confusion between overlapping intent categories.

projects.title: Bag-of-Words Baselines for Movie Review Sentiment Classification
bullets: Implemented unigram count features and logistic regression using scikit-learn to classify movie reviews by sentiment.
Compared count and TF-IDF representations on a held-out split, reviewing errors involving negation and mixed sentiment.
